description: This file defines a controller class for managing return statuses within the Opencart admin localization module. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting return status entries, as well as handling related views and permissions.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: Controller class for handling CRUD operations and views related to return statuses in the Opencart admin localisation module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the return status list view, setting up breadcrumbs, titles, and including header, footer, and sidebar components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of return statuses by calling getList and rendering the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares return status data, including pagination, for the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a return status, loading language, existing data, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or edited return status, including validation and permissions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return statuses after permission checks and validation for default or in-use statuses.
